templates.intro: Pick a template to use its sample, or to pour your own outline (e.g. from an AI) into its colors, layout and shapes.
templates.ownContent: Use it with your own content
templates.step1: Copy the AI prompt and send it to any AI together with your notes.
templates.step2: Copy the Markdown outline the AI replies with and paste it below.
templates.step3: Create — the map gets this template’s colors, layout and shapes.
templates.prompt:
Organize the content below into a mind map outline that follows this template’s structure (same levels; add or remove branches as the content needs). Reply with Markdown only, in one code block: the central topic as a level-1 heading (# ), main branches as level-2 headings (## ), details as bullet lists (- ) indented two spaces per level. Keep items short.

Template:
```markdown
{{outline}}```

My content:

trip.name: Trip plan
trip.description: A ticket for the trip, flags for each part, tags for the packing list.

archive.name: Knowledge base
archive.description: Folders for categories, tags for the documents inside.

process.name: Process
process.description: Steps in cut-corner boxes, a diamond for each yes/no check.

paste.prompt:
Turn the content below into a mind map outline. Reply with Markdown only, in one code block:
1. First line: the central topic as a level-1 heading (# ).
2. Main branches as level-2 headings (## ).
3. Details as bullet lists (- ), indenting two more spaces per level.
4. Keep every item to a few words or a short phrase — no paragraphs.
5. No explanations before or after the outline.
